title: Little Valley Bayou Water Control Structure (TV-0092)
intro: A three-stop look at this CPRA project: where it is, what it changes, and its status and funding.

steps.title: Where it's at
steps.body: This project is at Little Valley Bayou in Iberia Parish.

media.alt: Aerial view of Little Valley Bayou and the surrounding farmland and marsh, Iberia Parish (2024 aerial imagery).

steps.title: What it is changing
steps.body: Without a control structure, the bayou’s headwaters and nearby marshes take on unchecked tidal water, raising water levels upstream and increasing flood risk. CPRA is engineering, designing, and building a water control structure to regulate tidal and storm-surge intrusion while still letting rainwater drain freely, reducing flood risk for the surrounding community.

steps.title: Timeline / Completion Date
steps.body: Project Status: Headed to Bid (the project is preparing to accept construction bids). Estimated Cost: $6,286,569. Funding Source: State of Louisiana.
